user_authorization: Atharva explicitly accepts AI adjudication and requests completion of the original H4 task.

reference_policy.selection_reason: Latest completed worksheet supplied by the user; retain earlier reference as sensitivity, not select labels for better metrics.

judge_recovery_policy.triggers: Missing readable response only; never agreement, probability, label, or performance.
judge_recovery_policy.score_rule: Include all 100 pairs. Require a complete final response, or explicitly count a remaining failure using the unchanged team unreadable policy. Do not silently exclude any pair.
judge_recovery_policy.label: Mistral adaptive output budget: 4096, then 16384/32768 only after missing output

precision_policy.primary: Reproduce unchanged team scorer and its default JSON loader.
precision_policy.sensitivity: Also report exact source-value decoding; do not retune T or patch shared code.

completion_scope: AI-adjudicated H4 analysis and reviewable branch/PR; not a claim of human validation or team approval.

canonical_reference.note: Created by unchanged build-gold from worksheet, then explicitly annotated as user-accepted AI adjudication. Labels exactly match reference B.

recovery_probe.selection: First originally missing pair in frozen sample order; no label/performance used to choose it.

amendment_timing_note: AI-reference acceptance and recovery policy are a retrospective completion amendment after preliminary v2 NLI results. Recovery budget ladder was recorded before recovery predictions; no claim that the entire study was preregistered.
